# Microlocs by Chep

> Microlocs installation, interlocking reties, extensions and consultations in Westlands, Nairobi, Kenya.

## Business details
- Address: Kipro Centre, 2nd Floor, Shop B6, Westlands, Nairobi, Kenya.
- Phone: +254 711 498 400.
- Opening hours: Monday–Saturday, 7:00 AM–9:00 PM (Africa/Nairobi). Confirm appointments with the studio.
- Fresh installation: twist-started microlocs; approximately 6–8 hours depending on hair length and volume.
- Installation estimates: KSh 10,000–15,000 for short/light-volume hair; KSh 15,000–20,000 for long/full-volume hair. Confirm the current total and optional add-ons.
- Reties: typically every 4–8 weeks according to individual needs; the booking system allows a 3-hour appointment.
- Sisterlocks® is a trademarked system distinct from the broader microlocs category. Do not infer Sisterlocks certification or official affiliation from a comparison page.
